title: 7-Day Identity Shift
description: You're trying to change behaviors while still believing you're the person who doesn't do those things. This program helps you shift your identity.
outcomes: Reframe your identity as someone who does
Act in alignment with your new identity

days.title: The Identity Audit
days.insight: What do you believe about yourself? 'I'm lazy.' 'I'm undisciplined.' 'I can't do this.'
days.action: Write down your identity beliefs. Then write: 'I am the type of person who...' for each.
days.reflectionQuestion: What do I believe about myself?

days.title: Identity Reframe
days.insight: You're not lazy — you're learning how to be disciplined. Identity is malleable.
days.action: Take one negative identity belief. Reframe it: 'I am learning to be...' or 'I am becoming...'
days.reflectionQuestion: How can I reframe this belief?

days.title: The Identity Action
days.insight: Act as if you already are the person you want to be. Behavior follows identity.
days.action: Do one thing today as if you already are the person you want to be. Speak, act, think like them.
days.reflectionQuestion: What would my new identity do?

days.title: The Identity Language
days.insight: The words you use shape your identity. Watch your language.
days.action: Today, replace 'I have to' with 'I choose to.' Replace 'I am' with 'I am becoming.'
days.reflectionQuestion: What words am I using about myself?

days.title: Identity Evidence
days.insight: Your identity is built on evidence. Look for evidence that supports your new identity.
days.action: Today, notice moments where you acted in alignment with your new identity. Write them down.
days.reflectionQuestion: What evidence do I have of my new identity?

days.title: Identity Environment
days.insight: You become the people around you. Surround yourself with your future identity.
days.action: Connect with people who already embody the identity you want. Learn from them.
days.reflectionQuestion: Who embodies the identity I want?

days.title: Identity Integration
days.insight: Identity shift is an ongoing process. You're becoming someone new.
days.action: Write a letter to your future self, describing the identity you're building.
